# `aube dist-tag ls`

- **Usage:** `aube dist-tag ls [PACKAGE]`
- **Effect:** read-only

List every dist-tag for a package.

Reads the package name from `./package.json` when no argument is given.

<!-- docs-navigation:start -->

## Examples

```sh
aube dist-tag ls @acme/widget
```

Read the [workflow guide](/package-manager/publishing) for context.
[Global options](/cli/#global-flags) apply to this command too.

<!-- docs-navigation:end -->

## Arguments

- **`[PACKAGE]`** — Package name (no version).

  Defaults to the current project's `package.json` `name` field.

## Flags

- **`-h --help`** — Print help
